# Corion

Corion is the modern public intake surface for Corion Lackdoktor.

- Public intake and quote request: https://corion.app/
- Full business, services, locations and trust content: https://www.corion-lackdoktor.de/
- Existing user and partner login: https://app.corion.app/login
- Telephone: +49 176 83458274

Customers can describe vehicle damage, provide contact details and attach photos.
Successful submissions create a real Corion workshop order and return a reference number.
